Positivity for all positive times, the known 3-equilibrium census (independently rederived), omega-limit connectedness, and invariant compactness prove convergence for every initial vector. Uniform Hessian has one negative and L−1 positive directions and positive weighted path-Laplacian mobility, establishing a hyperbolic saddle. Endpoint triangular Jacobian eigenvalues are −1+1/L and −1, so both are sinks. Stable-manifold estimates give eventual exponential rate. KL identity on M=L/2 proves explicit basin barrier; standalone exact/rational verifier checks sampled algebraic identities but not infinite quantifiers.
